items.question: What are the main services offered by SRPTIQ?
items.answer: We specialize in building digital products from A to Z, including SaaS development, AI solutions, UX/UI design, and digital transformation consulting.

items.question: Can I order a custom product for my business?
items.answer: Absolutely. We believe every business has unique needs, so we build fully customized systems aligned with your workflow and strategic goals.

items.question: How do we start working with you on a new project?
items.answer: Simply click 'Start Your Project', and our team will contact you for an initial consultation to understand your needs and provide the best proposal.

items.question: What technologies do you use?
items.answer: We use cutting-edge technologies including Next.js, React, Node.js, Python, AI/ML frameworks, cloud solutions, and more.

items.question: Do you provide post-launch support?
items.answer: Yes, we provide comprehensive post-launch support, maintenance, and continuous improvement for all our products and systems.

items.question: Do you offer services for startups?
items.answer: Yes! We have a special startup package that includes MVP building at competitive prices with flexible payment plans tailored for early-stage companies.
